articleTitle: Metaverse for Public Welfare and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Metaverse is extremely popular at present in the gaming industry but can it accelerate the advancement of public services as defined by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs)? In particular, can metaverse provide any value to developing nations and how can the challenges and risks introduced by the metaverse be addressed through govrnment regulations and policies? This paper presents a systematic analysis of metaverse and utilizes the United Nations SDGs as a metric to explore public welfare aspects of metaverse. A digital transformation Lab is presented for rapid deployment and experimentation with metaverse.

articleTitle: Based on Mini Batch K-Means Clustering for Customer Segmentation in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In this study, we proposed a clustering method based on Mini Batch K-means with principal component analysis for customer segmentation in e-commerce big data. Taking the Kaggle dataset: Customer Personality Analysis, for example, the Mini Batch K-means method is obviously superior to other algorithms. Compared with K-means, Agglomerative, Birch, and Spectral methods, the Mini Batch K-means method has the smallest sum of squares of errors SSE. Through the Mini Batch K-Means with PCA clustering method, we divide e-commerce customers into five clusters. After exploring the characteristics of these five clusters, the corresponding precision marketing strategies were proposed.

articleTitle: The inference operation optimization of an improved LeNet-5 convolutional neural network and its FPGA hardware implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved LeNet-5 convolutional neural network (CNN) named MeLy-Net which is more suitable for implementing on the Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) by using quantization technique at the low power consumption. The parallel inference strategies of kernel layer and pooling layer operation in the MeLy-Net are discussed in detail. The high level synthesis (HLS) tool is used to form the accelerator Intellectual Property (IP), the PYNQ-Z2 development board with proceeding system (PS) and programming logic (PL) two parts is used to realize the complete deployment of the FPGA-based accelerator, and the ARM core on the PS side controls the MeLy-Net FPGA-based accelerator on the PL side through the AXI bus. The MNIST dataset tests show the 98.8% accuracy is achieved by the MeLy- Net. It can achieve high-speed handwriting digital image recognition of MNIST dataset under the low power consumption of 2.128W, and can finish 1000 images processing within only 1.8ms.

articleTitle: Recent Development on Extractive Rationale for Model Interpretability: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Interpretability is an important yet difficult issue for natural language understanding, which aims to understand the behaviour mode of deep neural models, and hence to obtain corresponding explanation for model prediction. For interpretability, extractive rationales are some highlights in the original input, which can sufficiently and comprehensively decide the label, while generative explanations are free texts, which describe the inference process with natural language. In this paper, we focus on extractive rationale, and give a detailed review on recent development. Specifically, firstly we will introduce the task formulation, evaluation metrics and datasets. Then we will introduce several kinds of rationale extraction models, including vanilla attribution algorithm, AA-based training, and select-predict pipeline. And we next list the diverse utilizations of rationale. Finally, we summarize the main challenges of this field.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Investigation of Temperature-Current Rise in PCB with different electrical current and trace width
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The performance of PCB is severely limited by the working temperature of PCB. Thus, it is necessary to study the relationship between the working temperature and factors, such as electrical current value, trace width, PCB thickness, PCB material and so on. In this research, the influence of the electronic current and trace width on the surface temperature distribution of PCB has been studied by establishing PCB simulation model and experiment. The close agreement between the results measured and finite element analysis was achieved. The results show that the working temperature decreases with the decrease of electrical current and increase of the wire width.

articleTitle: Online Teacher-Student Interpersonal Management under Crisis Conditions: A Sentiment Analysis through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Online teacher-student communication is an indispensable part to sustain education in crisis conditions. However, the teacher-student interpersonal relationship is more fragile in crisis, and thus interpersonal management becomes vital. This paper employed social media data and largescale questionnaire data to examine how to manage the interpersonal relationship through the subtle manipulation of text, picture, emoji, and voice messages in a teacher-student community under crisis conditions. This paper used python to automatically traced, extracted, and counted the use of text, picture, emoji, and voice messages in one year’s teacher-student online communication. The messages were processed through sentiment analysis through machine learning to explore the students’ emotions. Having a fuller understanding of students’ emotions, the interpersonal functions of these messages were further examined through a questionnaire to reach a solution of interpersonal management. The results show that the students' emotions were not overwhelmingly negative under crisis conditions. With the proper use of text, picture, emoji and voice messages, interpersonal management can be successfully achieved. The findings indicate that the careful choice of message types can facilitate the maintenance of teacher-student interpersonal relationships and teachers need to make fuller use of technology-mediated communication in a time of crisis.

articleTitle: Design of Fruit and Vegetable Produce Traceability System Based on Dual Chain and Dual Storage Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The "double chain and double storage" blockchain model for the fruit and vegetable supply chain was developed to address the ongoing issues with the agricultural quality control system. The "main chain + privacy chain" double chain model is used to limit storage growth, and the "database + block chain" method of storing on-chain and off-chain traceability data is intended to increase the blockchain's query efficiency. Based on Hyperledger Fabric. Designed a fruit and vegetable produce traceability system based on Hyperledger Fabric. The system was constructed using smart contract technology to filter and restrict the data upload. The experimental comparison analysis of the model is also conducted. The findings demonstrate that the dual-chain dual-storage model based on Hyperledger, which takes into account the openness, security, and information privacy of each link enterprise of the transaction information, can significantly increase the blockchain storage query efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Influencing Factors of Information Technology Adoption Behavior of Grape Growers in the Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Science and technology are the primary productive forces. Today, with the vigorous development of digital economy, how to promote the effective connection between poverty alleviation and rural revitalization is inseparable from the power of science and technology. Through the information construction of agriculture and the digital governance of rural areas, the modernization of agriculture and rural areas can be realized. This paper investigates the use of information technology by grape growers with the method of field investigation, and establishes a binary Logistic regression model by combining theory with practice. The results of the empirical analysis show that the degree of technology cognition, education, the cost of using information technology, the intensity of publicity, professional knowledge, access to information technology, age and the number of farmers are all significant factors affecting the Information technology adoption behavior of farmers. The purpose of this paper is to improve the level of agricultural information technology use among grape farmers, promote the digital development of agriculture, and build a new pattern of digital economy to promote high-quality agricultural development.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Combined Water Control Technology for High Temperature and High Pressure Deep Water Gas Reservoirs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The deep-water gas field in the South China Sea has been officially put into operation, but due to the strong energy of the bottom water in the offshore gas field, the production well is prone to water flooding, resulting in a serious decline in gas production. The problem of water control technology in the gas field has also become a difficult problem. In order to explore the water control mode suitable for the gas reservoir, Using MeLeod algorithm to establish physical model and complete mining process simulation. The experimental results show that the combination of segmented water control and continuous packer has the best water control effect.

articleTitle: Research on the characteristics of inbound tourism in Yangtze River Delta region based on big data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Tourism is an important strategic pillar industry of the national economy, and transportation is the foundation and prerequisite for the development of tourism. In recent years, comprehensive transportation system has been constantly improved, the integrated development of transportation and tourism has become a new trend. By using big data survey and analysis technology, this paper analyzes the characteristics of different types of tourism transportation in the Yangtze River Delta region, evaluates the accessibility of urban tourism transportation, and explores the relationship between traffic and tourism development. Moreover, the project optimizes the productivity distribution, promotes the development of tourism economy in a large range, and provides a more scientific decision basis for planning and investment of regional transportation project. In this paper, the big data analysis and means adopted in the analysis can provide certain reference for other subjects.

articleTitle: Exploration of classroom teaching reform in higher vocational colleges from the perspective of metaverse
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Based on the application review in the field of meta-universe teaching at home and abroad, this paper provides a new perspective for the reform of higher vocational classroom teaching based on the perspective of meta-universe, which is helpful to deepen the theoretical research of higher vocational classroom teaching reform and broaden the spatial dimension of traditional vocational teaching. It is proposed that the hybrid teaching mode empowered by the metaverse and multi-scenario integration will be the future development trend of classroom teaching in vocational colleges, innovate the talent training model, build diversified learning activities, and realize the digital transformation and intelligent upgrading of future vocational teaching.

articleTitle: Analysis of the clinical effect of the treatment and rehabilitation of autistic children under the background of big data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The incidence of children with autism is high and attracts the attention of researchers worldwide. Big data technology is the main driving force for children's rehabilitation, which will greatly promote the development of children's rehabilitation industry. Using big data to children's rehabilitation can meet the needs of integrating and sharing children's rehabilitation information resources, optimize the rehabilitation process, and promote the coordinated development of children's rehabilitation. This article, mainly from the relevant children treatment and intervention, combined with recent research hot point —fusion rehabilitation, summarized and comprehensively analyzed the status of the research related to children with autism under the background of big data, which aims to promote children with autism and families actively participate in and shape their life, promote the integration of society. It is necessary to provide enlightenment for the subsequent relevant rehabilitation institutions or hospitals to further carry out children's rehabilitation.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Service System of Land Big Data Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In the context of the rapid development of artificial intelligence and big data technology, the efficient use and integration of data are essential. As a tool for information carrying and knowledge reasoning in the context of big data, a knowledge graph helps to improve the utilization of land resources in villages and towns and the accurate supply of knowledge services. To effectively solve services such as land cultivation guidance, business guidance, and policy consultation, a land big data knowledge service system based on a knowledge graph is proposed. The construction framework and content of the land big data knowledge service system are studied from the technical and functional levels and applied to the land knowledge service platform to provide service functions such as intelligent retrieval, online consultation, land purchase and sale, and personalized recommendation. This service system is expected to provide reference and reference for the research, development, and technological innovation of villages and towns in the era of big data.

articleTitle: Research on Online and Offline Hybrid Teaching Mode of College English Writing for Non-English Majors Based on iWrite2.0
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In recent years, automatic writing evaluation software have gradually been applied to language teaching in Chinese universities in order to lighten the burden of writing teaching. However, due to the limitations of automatic evaluation software and the special features of writing course, the effectiveness of teaching still needs to be improved. Aiming at this problem, ¡Write 2.0 automatic writing evaluation software is integrated into the teaching of writing. Compared with the previous automatic writing evaluation software, iWrite 2.0 is based on associative word mining, Bi-RNN and big data corpus, guided by the theories of second language writing. It greatly improves the consistency of manual evaluation of automatic evaluation results. With the support of iWrite 2.0, this paper intends to construct an online and offline hybrid teaching mode for non English majors, following three principles---Engagement, Evaluation and Competition(EEC). this EEC hybrid teaching mode is applied to college English courses for freshmen lasting for one semester. The research findings have shown that this teaching mode could effectively improve students’ writing performances, enhance their participation in learning and reduce the writing anxiety of students. With rich writing resources, diversified evaluation and timely feedback provided by iWrite 2.0, this teaching mode has greatly improved the effectiveness of writing teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Test Data Processing Method in Condition Based Maintenance of Transformation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: With the comprehensive development of condition monitoring technology, condition-based maintenance will replace the traditional planned maintenance system and bring enormous economic benefits to power enterprises. The condition-based maintenance of transformation equipment can reflect all kinds of data of the running state of power equipment so as to comprehensively judge its state. This study uses statistical methods to compare all kinds of input data of transformer horizontally and vertically, which can solve the complex problem of statistical analysis and judgment of a large amount of data, and make the evaluation of transformer state more scientific. This method changes the present situation of evaluating the equipment state according to experience, and makes the suggestions of state maintenance of the state analysis function of computer intelligent diagnosis more reasonable.

articleTitle: Research on Patent Selection of High-Tech Enterprises under Supply Chain Risk
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The transformation of patent is of great significance to the innovation-driven development strategy. In the process of using patents for production, internal and external risks of high-tech enterprises often lead to uncertainty in their output, and COVID-19 has exacerbated the risks. Studying patent operation strategy of high-tech enterprises under such conditions is of great significance to the enterprises and even the supply chain as a whole. In order to study the problem of how companies choose among common patent strategies, previous studies have used algorithms to predict risk. This article constructs a two-party and three-party game model including high-tech suppliers. And the optimal patent strategy before and after supply chain coordination is discussed; The article gives the optimal patent strategy under different conditions. And it is found that regardless of the decentralized or centralized decision, the patent licensing strategy is superior when the potential profitability is small; the patent sharing strategy is superior when the potential profitability is large; and the patent monopoly strategy is superior only when the potential profitability is in the medium size.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Reinforcement Design and Bearing Capacity for External Prestressing Deviator Based on Strut-and-Tie Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Combined with the stress trace method and topology optimization diagram, the Strut-and-Tie Models in the stress disturbance regions of integrated and distributed deviators are constructed. Reinforcement design and numerical simulation are also conducted for the deviator based on the finite element software. The model internal forces are obtained based on the equilibrium condition to check the bearing capacity of the member. The change of deviators’ mechanical performance before and after reinforcement and the stress distribution law of hoop stirrup are studied. The result shows that the mechanical performance of the deviator is improved, the peak stress is reduced, and the stress of the reinforcing hoop stirrup is small, which is much less than the yield strength of the reinforcement.

articleTitle: A Study on Benchmark Management of Ecological Civilization Construction Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Demonstration with Typical Examples is an important strategic task in the construction of ecological civilization in China. The key is how to choose the appropriate "benchmark" for the construction goals of different ecological civilizations. Obviously, the "benchmark" has an important application value for the demonstration and construction of ecological civilization. Aiming at the current situation that there are few research results on the application of benchmarking management to the construction of ecological civilization and the system is not yet mature, a research method for text cases based on big data analysis technology is proposed. Firstly, the classification was carried out with K-mean clustering method, and then the benchmark cases under different classes were screened with the sentiment analysis technology based on the TF-IDF algorithm, and finally the learning path of the benchmarking cases was extracted by social network analysis technology. In this study, it is found that the big data analysis method can improve the accuracy and rationality of benchmark selection and improve the evaluation efficiency of the performance of ecological civilization construction.

Author Keywords: Sentiment Analysis based on TF-IDF Weights

articleTitle: Creation and Application of Inter-language CorporaBased on Language Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The establishment of corpus marks the scientific and modernization of linguistic research tools and promotes the continuous development of corpus-based research on the acquisition of Chinese as a second language. The establishment of inter-language corpus based on language information processing not only serves classroom teaching, but also draws new corpus in classes. At the same time, the expansion of the number and size of the corpus helps linguistic researchers understand the patterns of learners’ second language acquisition and conduct further research in a dynamically evolving corpus, which promotes the two-way development of teaching and learning.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Supervision of Green Production Based on XGBOOST Algorithm and Evolutionary Game Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In this study, we used the XGBoost algorithm to discuss the importance of green development satisfaction through questionnaire data and found that in terms of green development satisfaction, the government’s actions were the most important, followed by public transport and green space and other infrastructure provided by the government, and the enterprise’s green production performance ranked third. From the structural equation model, we know that the government’s actions not only directly affect the people’s satisfaction with green development but also directly affect the green production behavior of enterprises. Under the causal relationship of government supervision and green production of enterprises, we constructed an evolutionary game model to analyze the best game strategies of both the government and the enterprise.

articleTitle: Musical Instrument Timber-evoked EEG Classification Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Timber is a major attribute of musical sound perception and an important aspect of the hearing evaluation. With the development of brain science and neuroscience, how to use electroencephalogram (EEG) signals to identify musical instrument timbers raises concerns. In this paper, we studied the classification of EEG signals evoked by musical instrument timber based on deep learning methods. First, an oddball paradigm was designed to collect the auditory EEG signals when musical instrument sounds (piano, violin and trumpet) were played to a normal hearing (NH) subject. Then the spatial and temporal characteristics of the EEG data were analysed and the event-related potentials (ERPs) could be found after about 400 ms. Based on these features, four deep learning models were used to classify the EEG data. The experimental results showed that the two neural network models with spatiotemporal decoding structures had better performance than other two models, and their classification accuracies were all up 80% above. It is concluded that the design of musical instrument sounds-evoked EEG experimental paradigm is reasonable, and the proposed deep learning methods can be used objectively to evaluate the hearing of the subject for musical instrument timber.

articleTitle: Research on data cleaning in big data environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: With the rise of the big data technology storm in the computer field, the scale effect of big data computing has also brought great challenges to the storage, processing, management and visual analysis of computer data, and different data types, so the data will be mixed with incomplete, repeated or even wrong "dirty data". The direct output of these 'dirty data' will seriously affect the accuracy and efficiency of data decision-making. It can lead to incomprehensible results. Therefore, data cleaning of raw data is a key link in the process of big data analysis and application. This article elaborates on the overview and classification of data quality, the principle and basic process of data cleaning, and the methods of data cleaning [1].

articleTitle: Power Companies Labour Scale Demand Prediction Calculation Model Based on the COBB-Douglas Function
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: This article builds a model prediction model that can meet the total number of labour scale that can meet the company's business development goals and labor cost constraints at the same time. This model comprehensively considers the impact of various factors of labour scale prediction of large power supply companies. The total number of labour scale of the traditional labour scale with labour capital proxy makes the model design more scientific and reasonable. Verify the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Big Data Application in the Course of Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: With the development of the times, the combination of big data and education has become an inevitable requirement for the development of educational teaching. This article mainly discusses the following aspects. Firstly integrating big data ideas and technologies into the course of supply chain management, starting with big data mining of supply chain professional employment market to help students understand the current social needs. Secondly, collecting teaching and past students’ learning data, build an integrated database, and help teachers integrate teaching resources. Thirdly, using big data information gathering technology and investigation to determine the teaching content and methods, bringing network combat and role simulation experiment into the classroom. Finally, using the big data education platform to collect the students’ daily learning data and count the final examination results, the multi-dimensional assessment method is formed.

articleTitle: Demand Forecasting and Optimizing Collaborative Dispatching of Epidemic Prevention and Emergency Supplies in Urban Agglomeration at the Early Stage of Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: When there is a big outbreak of a contagious disease, there aren't enough emergency supplies to stop the disease from spreading quickly. We need to do two things to solve this real- world problem: predict future demand and figure out the best way to schedule our reserves. Firstly, we combine the characteristics of how infectious disease epidemics spread between cities with population flow. Then, we introduce a modified SEIR model to simulate the spread of infectious disease epidemics within urban agglomerations, scientifically predict the number of infected people, scientifically define emergency medical material units, and effectively predict the total amount of materials needed. Secondly, we built a systematic optimization model for locating and sending emergency supplies to prevent epidemics based on how many supplies are expected to be needed in the area. This model takes into account how forecasting, stockpiling, and dispatching work together. It can also figure out where temporary dispatch points are and how materials get from one demand point to another. We choose the Shandong Peninsula Urban Agglomeration in China for the applied research. The goal is to use science to help make sure that emergency relief work in the region goes smoothly.

articleTitle: The Empirical test on the impacts of crise variables on tourism based on a demand model with the inbound data to china
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: This study highlights the importance of crisis variables in tourism, where a demand model is computed to some significant changes in tourists when crises or disaster hit in 1999-2018, to examine the negative impacts of crisis valuables caused by weather or epidemic diseases on tourism. The results show that the correlation between tourism income, tourism price and the number of inbound tourists is usually an important factor affecting the number of tourists. More importantly, crisis variables such as climate, safety and health-related crises have had a heavily negative impact on tourism. And health valuable is the first factor of tourism consideration, which has a great impact. Therefore, it is proposed to improve the level of government management, consolidate the tourism industry, improve the quality of practitioners, optimize the quality of service, and actively guide the tourism industry to the development of ecological tourism, health tourism and safety tourism

articleTitle: Nonexistence of single peaked solution for a fifth-order Camassa-Holm equation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a fifth-order Camassa-Holm equation, which describes the unidirectional propagation of waves on a stationary shallow water free surface at infinity. By using the properties of the unit shock function, we proved that there is no peaked solution to the fifth order Camassa Holm equation through Fourier transformation and a large number of numerical calculations.

articleTitle: A Sensitive Data Protection Framework Based on TrustZone
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The development of the Internet has made mobile devices become an indispensable part of work for people to store and process sensitive data. Protecting data through encryption algorithms is one of the best ways to solve data security problems at the current stage. However, traditional solutions only focus on the security of encrypted data, and cannot guarantee the security of data during the encryption process. Therefore, in view of the security problems of traditional data encryption, A sensitive data protection framework is proposed in this paper. The encryption process is security enhanced by implementing the data encryption process in the Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). The uniqueness and security of the keys are guaranteed by generating the keys related to the device and the application. The prototype system is implemented based on Qemu. Finally, experiments show that this framework has good security and feasibility with little increase in overhead.

articleTitle: Realization Path and Scheme for Electronic Original Records of EMC Tests
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The original test record is a key basis for the authenticity of tests and also an important part for issuing a report. In order to improve the quality and work efficiency of the EMC test report, the implementation of electronic original records is imperative. In this paper, the design scheme and path for realizing electronic original records of tests in an electromagnetic compatibility laboratory are proposed based on the standard requirements for original records of EMC Tests.

articleTitle: Research on the abnormal state of train brake chains based on target detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Railway transport is the main mode of transport in China, and timely detection of abnormalities in trains during railway operation can effectively avert disasters. Holding brake is a type of anomaly detection. The brake chain, as an indicator of the brake, is the key to the study of the state of the train in motion. Based on the object detection algorithm, this paper detects the moving train brake chain from the aspects of one-stage and two-stage, and determines the abnormal situation of the train through its tightness. Firstly, the railway brake chain data set is constructed, and the target categories of the data are defined as slack brake chain, taut brake chain and duct, considering the overall nature of the brake chain and duct; then the detection frame, category and confidence level of the target are obtained by YOLOv3 and Faster RCNN algorithm models respectively; finally, based on the detection results of the previous step, if there is a taut brake chain, it is judged as anomalous, i.e. output "Anomalous!". The results show that the accuracy of YOLOv3 and Faster RCNN algorithm models for brake chain anomaly detection is 91.324187% and 93.108396% respectively, which effectively warn the brake chain anomalous state.

articleTitle: Application of Linear Motor on CNC Lathe
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Aiming at the design requirements of the submicron accuracy of CNC lathe and taking the FANUC linear motor as an example, this paper describes the specific selection method and assembly and adjustment method of the linear motor, studies the key technologies such as the servo adjustment of the CNC system, discusses how to improve the dynamic response of the CNC lathe at high speed, and finally achieves the submicron positioning accuracy of the CNC lathe.

articleTitle: Double Iterative Algorithm for Symmetric Solution of Multi-variable Quadratic Matrix Equation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In this article, a double iterative methods is suggested for solving symmetric matrix of multi-variable quadratic matrix equation. Firstly, the symmetric matrix of a quadratic matrix equation is transformed into the symmetric matrix of the corrected matrix equation by the Newton's algorithm. Then, we develop a modified conjugate gradient algorithm (MCG) for finding a symmetric solution of the modified equation. A numerical example is offered to show the inefficiency of the double iterative methods.

articleTitle: Application and Research of Machine Learning in Traditional Chinese Medicine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and the accumulation of medical big data, machine learning algorithms are increasingly being used in clinical settings, and it will become particularly important to be able to efficiently and accurately obtain valuable information from these large-scale data, which also brings unprecedented opportunities and challenges to the field of Chinese medicine, driving the development of clinical and scientific research in Chinese medicine. At present, machine learning algorithms commonly used in the field of Chinese medicine include random forest, support vector machine, logistic regression and convolutional neural network, etc. This paper will focus on the application of random forests and convolutional neural networks in the field of Chinese medicine.

articleTitle: Research on the intelligent application scenarios of big data technology in customs declaration and clearance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The 21st century belongs to the century of the Internet, the frequency of big data exchange is becoming more and more frequent, and all walks of life are actively strengthening the research and use of big data technology. A country’s customs has the important mission of guarding the security of the country and promoting foreign trade, so it is very important to effectively and safely use big data in customs clearance and customs clearance while realizing the intelligence of the regulatory process. This paper analysis the value and characteristics of big data in the application of international trade customs clearance. At the same time, an operation example of "investigating and handling false exports" is used to show the intelligent supervision scenario of big data customs clearance. Take Nansha Customs and Guangzhou Customs as examples to show the intelligent application of big data in customs. Finally, the future development trend and prospect of big data in customs clearance are further prospected.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Rules Reduction Based on the Least Angle Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: High-dimensional data bring ‘Rule Explosion’. How to reduce the fuzzy rules becomes a novel research hotspot. In this paper, we proposed a rules-reduction model. In this proposed model we employ the idea of the sparse reconstruction algorithm to reduce the redundant rule, and transform the fuzzy rule reduction problem into the optimum solution of sparse reconstruction algorithms. We first compute fuzzy basis functions in order to represent the output signal. The expression function of the outputs signal can be seen as the sparse representation function with unknown parameters. Least angle regression algorithm is employed as an optimal method to solve the sparse reconstruction model. In the last section we use the proposed model to model time serial data, our algorithm performs better than Genfis2 and Genfis3.

articleTitle: Research on the development of port and shipping industry in the post-epidemic era based on gray relevance model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: This paper will focus on the statistical situation of China's port shipping industry system from June 2020 to June 2021, and use the grayrelevance model to conduct an empirical analysis of the system. The results show that there is a strong correlation between the five indicators of China's port shipbuilding system after the epidemic and the three indicators of the economic and social system, and there is uncertainty about the correlation intensity of the indicators before and after the epidemic.

articleTitle: Application and Trend Analysis of Artificial Intelligence in Weighing Apparatus
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: This paper introduces the new discipline of artificial intelligence technology in China.Combined with the development history of weighing instruments, it expounds that the intelligent development of the industrial chain of weighing instruments industry is inseparable from artificial intelligence. By introducing the penetration of artificial intelligence in the weighing instrument field, this paper describes the speech recognition technology and machine vision system technology, and gives a detailed example of the application of the two technologies in the weighing instrument intelligence, which leads to the problems and analysis of artificial intelligence in the weighing instrument industry. Finally, a predictive analysis of the future integration and development trend of artificial intelligence and weighing instruments is made.

articleTitle: Big Data Based Secure Access System of Power Mobile Terminal
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: A big data based secure access system of power mobile terminal is put forward to ensure the security of power system. The access system architecture of power mobile terminal is analyzed comprehensively, and the system is designed according to the principle of network dedicated and security partition. In addition, after designing the overall structure of the secure access system, the targeted encryption technology is used to encrypt data in the secure communication module. As the key of secure access, the designed terminal system needs to meet its reliability and security in design. Meanwhile, the network security protection, terminal security protection and application security are designed. As can be seen through the implementation process of the system, the system can meet the actual demand and enhance the reliability and security of power transfer access.

articleTitle: Computation of Mechanical Performance for Externally Prestressed Steering Device under Different Steering Modes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In order to study the influence of the two types of steering methods, namely, integrated type and distributed type, on the mechanical performance of the externally prestressed steering device, the numerical simulation models of the two steering types were established respectively. The validity of the computation model was verified by comparing with available literature experimental data. The research shows that the steering type has a great influence on the mechanical performance of the steering device. Compared with the integrated type, the maximum compressive stress of the distributed type steering method on the steering device is reduced by more than 90%, and the maximum tensile stress is reduced by more than 50%. For the maximum Mises stress of the steering steel pipe, the distributed type reduced by about 85% compared to the integrated type. Different steering types have less effect on the stress distribution of the steering device. The stress distribution of the two steering devices is basically the same, which is compressed above the steering tunnel and pulled below the steering tunnel. In practical project, due to the good force characteristics of the distributed type steering device and considering the maintenance and repair in the operation phase, it is recommended to use the distributed type steering device.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Mountainous Roadside Slopes Under Typhoon Disaster Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In order to assess the risk of roadside slopes under typhoon disasters and help pre-disaster control of mountainous road, a risk assessment model of the roadside slopes based on big data analysis is constructed. Through the analysis of risk assessment theory, a unified risk assessment model considering multi-level and multi-factor is deduced. The data of 48 typhoons that have affected Ningbo since 2000 were obtained by checking meteorological data. Through inspection of mountain roads in Haishu District, the technical condition and surrounding environment data of 219 slopes were collected, and a status database of slopes was established. Each slope requires 56 data from screening to evaluation, so the total amount of data to evaluate the risk condition of 219 mountain slopes under 48 typhoons can reach 588,672. This risk evaluation has many indicators and complex calculations, and has obvious big data characteristics. Relying on the Alibaba Cloud platform, using big data analysis and based on risk assessment theory, a slope risk assessment system under typhoon disasters was built to help road management departments make risk control decisions. In the case study, the risk assessment of the mountainous roadside slopes in Haishu District of Ningbo City under the typhoon "In-Fa" in 2021 was carried out, and the results verified the feasibility of this risk assessment method.

articleTitle: Analysis and Forecast of Demand for Cold Chain Logistics of Agricultural Products in Shanghai in the Context of The Covid Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Forecasting the demand for cold chain logistics of agricultural products will help to achieve the balance between supply and demand of agricultural products and promote the healthy development of the cold chain logistics industry of agricultural products. This paper collects relevant data from 2015 to 2020 in Shanghai, and uses grey correlation analysis to conduct correlation analysis on the factors influencing the demand for cold chain logistics of fresh agricultural products. The traditional GM (1,1) model, the new information GM (1,1) model and the metabolism GM (1,1) model are used to forecast the demand for cold chain logistics of agricultural products in Shanghai in the next five years respectively. The grey correlation analysis shows that the employees of the tertiary industry and the total import and export of goods have the greatest impact on the market demand of cold chain logistics and the results of the three GM (1,1) models show that the sum of squared errors of using the new information GM (1,1) model is smaller. Finally, using the new information GM (1,1) model to forecast the demand for cold chain logistics of agricultural products in Shanghai from 2021 to 2025, and it is found that the overall demand for agricultural cold chain in Shanghai is on an upward trend.

articleTitle: Thinking and Exploration of Using Information Technology to Improve the Calculation and Management Level of Reliable Value of New Energy Stations under the New Situation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Relay protection setting calculation and setting list management have always been the difficulties and weak links in the operation and maintenance of new energy stations. This paper mainly takes the wind power station as an example, from four aspects: the calculation of the wind farm's relay value, the wind farm's relay value list management, the difficulties in the wind farm's relay value work, and the application of information technology in the future relay value management. Discuss the problems existing in the calculation and management of the current wind power station's relay value. This article puts forward its own opinions on the problems existing in the calculation of the relay protection setting value and the management of the setting value list, and provides reference and reference for the staff engaged in the relay protection setting value of the new energy power station.

articleTitle: Fluorescence recognition of lysine and a novel chiral BINOL complex calculated by using the Hildebrand-Benesi equation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: A novel fluorescent sensor was efficiently synthesized by nucleophilic substitution, addition, and click reactions using binaphthyl phenol as a substrate. After the synthesis, a series of analyses were performed on the fluorescent sensor based on the database obtained from extensive testing experiments and the synthetic formulae. From the analysis of the test data, it was found that the fluorescence sensor showed high enantioselectivity for lysine after the addition of 15 amino acids, with L-lys showing an enhanced fluorescence response to the probe, while D-Lys was almost unchanged. In the presence of 20.0 eq. of lysine, the enantioselective fluorescence enhancement ratio was as high as 77.50. Therefore, the novel probe synthesized can be used to identify and distinguish between different conformations of lysine.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Application of Wearable Electronic Products Based on Citespace
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In the core database of web of science, 1210 data sources with "sports", "wearable", "sports wearable equipment" and "behavioral performance" as keywords were selected. Based on Citespace software, this paper conducts visual processing and analysis to sort out and analyze the application effect of wearable electronic products in the sports field as a whole, thereby revealing the research trends, research focuses, and evolution paths and directions of wearable electronic products.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Optimal Fourth-order Uniparametric Family Iterative Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: We mainly research the stability of a family of uniparametric optimal fourth-order iterative method by using complex dynamics tools. An affine transformation is used to simplify the analysis while the qualitative properties keep invariant. The fixed points of the iterative method are studied and the stability of these strange fixed points is analyzed. Subsequently, we show the parameter space related to the critical point, and select the parameter values in the parameter space to obtain an iterative family with stable and unstable behavior. Finally, we find that the most stable member of the iteration family is $k = - \frac{1}{2}$.

articleTitle: Text Research on Promoting the Transformation of Scientific and Technological Achievements Based on NVivo
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The Regulations on Promoting the Transformation of Scientific and Technological Achievements in Sichuan Province have been implemented for nearly three years, but there are still many problems in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements. Therefore, to systematically understand the specific implementation of "Regulations" to promote the transformation of scientific and technological achievements into productive forces, combined with the relevant regulations from 2015 to 2020, using NVivo qualitative analysis software and Rothwell and other three kinds of policy tools, evaluates and analyzes the contents in the policies after coding and classifying, points out the possible problems in the policies, and gives corresponding suggestions. It is of practical significance to improve the legislative work of science and technology and improve the formulation and implementation level of regulations.

Author Keywords: The transformation of scientific and technological achievements

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Optimization Decision Support Platform of Solid Waste Environmental Risk Event Disposal Technology Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: With the advent of the Internet information age, the big data technology is constantly developing and maturing. The combination of data storage, mining, analysis and application with environmental governance is an important direction of future environmental management. The data related to environmental governance is very complex, and the value of many environmental data has not been excavated. With the abundance of various data collection equipment, the accuracy of data is also getting higher and higher. At present, very rich data information has been accumulated. According to the literature survey, at present, the utilization of unstructured data in the environmental field in China is mainly remote sensing data, while the utilization of other network unstructured data is not sufficient. In order to improve the level of environmental management, the comprehensive utilization of multi-source data is a top priority. This study takes the complaints on the official website of Suzhou Municipal Bureau of Ecology and Environment from 2015 to 2021 as the research data, builds a case base and technical base for solid waste environmental risk events, establishes a technical optimization model for emergency disposal of solid waste environmental risk events based on MCDM and TOPSIS, and designs a comprehensive management platform for solid waste environmental risk events, which can provide decision-makers with a technical optimization scheme for solid waste risk event disposal. This method is the combination of intelligent technology and big data technology, which can further promote the application and development of big data technology in the environmental field.

articleTitle: Practical Study on the Application of Affective Information Processing Model in Online Classroom
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Affective information processing model is a new multidisciplinary research field, which specializes in exploring how to use modern technology to process irrational and non-logical affective information such as feelings, impressions, emotions and feelings in human mind. Applying affective information processing model to online teaching can strengthen the emotional interaction between teachers and students, promote the emotional connection between teachers and students, and make up for the problems of less communication, insufficient interaction and lack of feedback between teachers and students in online teaching. It provides an operable way for online teaching based on the Internet in modern society, and is a proven method to improve the effect of online teaching.

articleTitle: Network construction of small and medium-sized enterprises based on virtual cloud WEB in the information age
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Internet and the promotion of the epidemic, the construction of enterprise networking is becoming more and more important. Website construction has become an essential part of enterprise development. However, small and medium-sized enterprises are facing economic and human pressures. Enterprise website, online office, online mall VPN, forums and other services for the development of the company is particularly important. Through the investigation and analysis of 20 small and medium-sized enterprises, domestic and foreign academic papers and online data, this paper introduces the importance of cloud on enterprise network, constructs the virtual cloud construction system based on CMS, and provides solutions from the aspects of capital cost, hardware procurement, software environment, system development, later operation and maintenance and labor cost, so as to realize simple, rapid, efficient, safe and low- cost deployment. At the same time, it meets the development of enterprise science and technology, perfects and summarizes the architecture model, realizes the demand of network construction of small and medium-sized enterprises efficiently and quickly, and encourages the development of entrepreneurs and small and medium-sized enterprises.

articleTitle: Research analysis on the application of big data and artificial intelligence in Chinese medicine diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The application of modern technologies such as big data and artificial intelligence in life and work has inspired scholars to apply them to Chinese medicine diagnosis. And the application of big data is just the right way to digitise and organise and classify millennia of knowledge, experience and literature on Chinese medicine diagnosis. Based on this, the robot will be made intelligent through artificial intelligence-related technology, thus promoting the transmission, development and innovation of Chinese medicine diagnosis. In this paper, the literature is obtained by searching the title "Big Data TCM" or "Artificial Intelligence TCM" on CNKI. The obtained literature was read, analyzed and summarized in order to provide theoretical help for further realizing the objectification of TCM diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on a Kind of Self-propelled Sawing Equipment for Snow and Ice Removal
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In winter, it is easy to accumulate snow and ice on the road after rain and snow, so effective snow and ice removal equipment is of great importance. To enhance the capability of equipment, a new self-propelled snow and ice removal equipment was developed. The basic structure and working principle of the equipment are introduced with the force on the saw-type rack analyzed. In addition, the crawler-type self-propelled chassis was selected in the light of the working characteristics of the equipment. The power computing of snow and ice removal equipment is of great significance to the efficiency of snow and ice removal. The power was checked through theoretical computing, so that gasoline engines with different power were selected to provide power for equipment moving and snow and ice removal mechanism. Power computing results showed that the new self-propelled snow and ice removal equipment had a unique structural design, and can adopt a cam mechanism to carry out horizontal reciprocating sawing, which had a good work efficiency and practicality for snow and ice removal.

Author Keywords: Equipment for snow and ice removal

articleTitle: Application of Two Threshold Level in Switching CFAR Processor for Improving Detection Probability in the Homogenoues and Non-homogenoues Environments
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Radar signal processing wants to distinguish between false and true targets and fix their rates in different radar environments. In this paper, based on Switching Constant False Alarm Rate (SCFAR) processor, a new version of it with the name Double Threshold Switching CFAR (DTS) has been implemented to reduce the false alarm rate not just in thermal noise-only homogeneous environments but also in non-homogeneous environments with clutter edges and numerous targets. Swerling I and the goal of the closed form were presupposed in order to arrive at the equation. The simulation results show that the proposed processor may reduce detection loss while reducing the false alarm rate in both homologous and non-homologous environments. Additionally, compared to other sample order processors, this approach is simpler to construct.

articleTitle: A Newton-Type Iterative Method for Computing Matrix Sign Function
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: A new iterative method for the matrix sign function is presented. We proved that this method has sixth-order convergence. The stability analysis of the method is discussed. The effectiveness of the results is illustrated by computational experiments.

articleTitle: Research on 3D hand information acquisition based on binocular camera
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: It is important to acquire hand spatial position information in a non-contact form when hand-impaired patients are undergoing assisted rehabilitation training. In this paper, we build a 3D reconstruction platform based on binocular vision camera, and adopt the Zhang Zhengyou calibration method to calibrate the binocular camera with high accuracy; combined with SGM(semi-global matching) algorithm, a fast and efficient matching method is given to obtain the parallax map; and transform it into point cloud information. The experimental results show that: the average error of reconstruction within 2m of the method is within 5%, and the error gradually increases with the increase of distance; the average time of single reconstruction is 3.566s, which meets the requirement of rapid acquisition of hand 3D information.

articleTitle: Software Platform Architecture Design for Relay Protection Setting Calculation of New Energy Stations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: New energy station relay protection fixed value check is an important means to ensure the reliable operation of power transmission and transformation equipment. Informatization and standardization, as important means to improve operation and management efficiency of power generation enterprises, are the general trend.Therefore, it is necessary to study the intelligent check method of relay protection fixed value. Firstly, the on-line check and intelligent setting system architecture of relay protection setting are studied. The popular SpringBoot architecture is used as the back-end framework to develop the system, and Vue.js is chosen as the front-end framework. Basic configuration and system management, relay protection fixed value calculation, relay protection fixed value management, trip management and other modules are researched and developed, and achieve overall design goals through interrelationships between these modules.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Bus Operation Efficiency Based on Data Acquisition and CCR Model-Take Xi'an City As An Example
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The article collects the daily passenger flow of 10 selected bus lines during peak hours through the “vehicle investigation”, then process the data to eliminate useless data. To support the national “bus first” policy, the operation efficiency of bus routes is evaluated. This essay introduces the DEA index evaluation system to frame out the five influencing factors of road transportation, i.e the line attribute, transportation capacity, passenger feedback, etc. Ten bus lines in Xi'an are selected, combined with the known network parameters and map ranging function, using the ratio of input and output indicators of CCR formula, then simplify it to a linear planning model. Finally, matlab programming algorithm is used to determine the efficiency value of each bus line, then put forward suggestions for improvement of the lines that have not achieve effectiveness.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analyzing of Slope Rainwater Seepage Field Based on Different Rainfall Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Established geological generality model and finite element model to research the slope stability under different rainfall conditions.The results showed that the seep and slop modules of Geo-studio geotechnical engineering simulation software are applicable to analyze the typical slope stability. And the slope is in a stable state during four rainfall conditions. It should be carry out geological disaster prevention and control according to the specific rainfall and rainfall time.

articleTitle: A globally convergent nth-Order Iterative Method for Computing the Matrix Sign Function
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In this paper, a generalized iterative method is proposed for the matrix sign function, which is proven to converge globally and stability. The general method has global convergence with arbitrary order n, some existing methods can be seen as the special cases of the proposed method. Numerical results show that the generalized method has good stability and convergence.

articleTitle: Research on the end-game of DouDizhu: A method to improve AI of imperfect information game
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The imperfect information game has too much hidden information in the game process, which leads to the huge information set in the game process. It is difficult to solve the problem through the mature game search algorithm. This paper takes the game guessing as the carrier, imitates the game behavior of human beings in the game remnant state, and gives a method to transform the imperfect information game into the perfect information game. Through this method, the other players' hands in the game are guessed, and the imperfect information is transformed into perfect information, so as to solve the problem that the data dimension brought by the hidden information of the game is too large Questions. As for the game of DouDizhu, in the end of game, there are 133 kinds of ending states. In this paper, the game information generated in the process of DouDizhu is studied, the appropriate representation method of game information is given, and a reasonable 3D time series convolution model is designed to extract features, and then a classification model with high accuracy of guessing cards is obtained. The model has a high accuracy of 92.1% for the final game. The perfect game search algorithm is used to solve the game's hand out strategy to improve the game AI's playing strength.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Digital Technology in Rural Landscape from the Perspective of Rural Revitalization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: "When the countryside prospers, the country prospers." Building a digital village is not only a strategic development direction for rural revitalization, but also an important summary of the construction of a digital China. In the change and development of the information age, the science and technology link with art closer and closer, and the research and practice of digital technology in the field of design are becoming more and more extensive. Meanwhile, the State has vigorously carried out rural construction, comprehensively promoted rural revitalization. Based on the understanding of digital technology, the authors analyzed the digital design and planning system in the construction of the rural environment, and looked forward to the development trend of digital design and application in the construction of the rural environment, and the ideal form of jointly-building smart villages was established.

articleTitle: A Family of Stenffensen-type Methods with Sixth-order Convergence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new family of Stenffensen- type methods with sixth-order convergence for solving nonlinear equations. The convergence order of the new method is proved by applying the first-order divided difference instead of the first-order derivative. Numerical experiments show that the proposed iterative methods have significant advantages over other proposed sixth-order iterative methods.

articleTitle: Complete Synchronization of Nonlinear Complex Networks with Time-delay and Unknown Parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The adaptive complete synchronization for a class of complex networks with dynamic parameters and time-delay is studied. Due to environment and human factors will interfere with the networks and system, thus unknown parameters and time-delay are added to the dynamic equations of the model in order to study how the delays and parameters affect the dynamic behavior. Therefore, the model that we have constructed is more general. In addition, we propose a controller to solve the networks synchronization problem based on Lyapunov stability principle, which simple and useful. Finally, we use our own model for numerical simulation and verify the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Cultural Tourism Management and Innovation based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Based on online comments, this paper uses big data analysis methods to explore the factors that affect tourists’ satisfaction with the historical and cultural block of Fuzhou’s three lanes and seven alleys. It is beneficial for general tourists and tourism operators to plan travel itineraries, and it is also beneficial for scenic spot managers to maintain and manage facilities and improve services. Through the semantic network, sentiment analysis, and LDA topic model analysis, it is found that the factors that affect tourists’ satisfaction mainly focus on local features, scenic spots, commercial development, and overall feelings.

articleTitle: Analysis on Spatial Layout of Rural Community Public Service Facilities Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Rural community is the basic unit of rural society. Strengthening the rational layout and scientific allocation of public facilities will help to improve the public service level of rural community and meet the needs of rural residents for livable life. Based on the big data of Internet map, the public service facilities and the spatial distribution characteristics of "15-minute community life circle" in Pinggu District of Beijing were analyzed by using the methods of nuclear density analysis, average nearest neighbor analysis and network analysis. 8 types of community public in villages and towns were measured under three modes of transportation: walking, cycling and automobile driving, including community comprehensive services, educational institutions, medical and health care, culture and sports, social welfare, life services, disaster prevention and avoidance, and industrial development. The results show that: ① The spatial distribution of public service facilities in Pinggu District is uneven, and the nuclear density centers are mostly concentrated in the areas with higher economic level in the south; ② From the perspective of the coverage rate of public facilities, the overall level of necessary facilities for residents in rural communities is high under the modes of automobile driving and cycling. But under the walking mode, the space coverage rate of cultural and sports facilities and public toilets is the lowest, and the supply gap is the largest; The coverage rate of medical and health facilities and social welfare facilities is around 70%, which needs to be further improved. This paper provides theoretical basis and reference for finding weak areas and rational layout planning of public service facilities in rural communities by using the big data of Internet map.

articleTitle: Investigation of Accelerated Life Test on the Conductive Slip Ring of Ship’s Platform Inertial Navigation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The conductive slip ring is an important part of the frame-type turntable, which is mainly used for signal transmission between continuously-rotating frames. The service life of the conductive slip ring is a key technical indicator of the frame-type turntable, and it directly determines the reliability of the turntable. In this investigation, the conductive slip ring was designed optimally, improved and innovated by applying the computing simulation and simulation technology of the simulation cloud platform, thereby the rapid analogy verification on the cloud computing simulation analysis model and the physical model was realized, and the service life of the conductive slip ring was verified. In this paper, the key factors affecting the service life of the conductive slip ring are studied; and an experimental verification method for the accelerated life of the conductive slip ring is proposed based on the calculation simulation of the simulation cloud platform.

articleTitle: The Slope Stability Analysis Based on the Finite Element Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Using midas/gts to simulate the stability of three typical slopes under ultra-large rain condition at mountain area in Zhejiang province. The results showed that the deformation of slope and the range of plastic zone are different under different geological conditions during ultra-large rain. The influence range of plastic zone is concentrated on the surface mostly in slope 1, and the deformation that is distributed at the bottom of slope 1 is not large. The influence range of plastic zone and the deformation at the bottom of slope 2 is lager than slope 1. This will affect the normal life of the villagers at the bottom of the slope 2. Slope 3 is located in the steep mountain area, but the deformation is not occur in the bottom under ultra-large rain due to the smaller slope anger. Therefore, the prevention and control of geological disasters need numerical simulation and field investigation, and combined with the monitoring of slope deformation for prevention and remediation.

articleTitle: Adversarial Performance Evaluation and Analysis on Recent Strong Models for Fact Verification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Nowadays automatic fake news detection has been under increasing attention. And fact extraction and verification (FEVER) has come with continuing study. The task aims at tracing corresponding fact evidences from hundreds of thousands of trusted Wikipedia documents, and then automatically judge the reliability of the targeted claims. Recently, a set of great models have been proposed for fact verification and they have made significant improvement. However, it keeps unexplored whether they have actually understood the semantic and logic relations between the claims and the evidences. In this paper, we start with negation logic, and adopt a logic-based method to generate adversarial samples. Then we select three of recent strongest fact verification models, and exam their performance on these samples. Our experiment results indicate that although these models show excellent performance on the original task, they get totally puzzled on the adversarial samples. And the performance damage on adversarial samples can be considered as an out-of-distribution problem. Therefore, it is infeasible to directly adopt the models for real-world application on automatic fake news detection.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Flexible Machining Cell(FMC)-Take Machining the Connecting Rod Parts as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Flexible machining is a part of intelligent manufacturing. This paper introduces the composition of flexible machining cell. Taking the machining of the parts of connecting rod as an example, it states the configuration structure of intelligent and flexible machining cell, summarizes the software and hardware configuration of flexible manufacturing cell, studies the network communication of flexible machining cell and the realization method of flexible machining, and describes the production of flexible machining cell in details, and systematically analyzes the general implementation steps of flexible machining cell.

articleTitle: Intelligent Internet of Things Cyber-Physical System for the Protection of Consumers’
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The quality of nutrition, physiologically balanced, environmentally friendly and healthy food contributes to the extension of human life. Global digitalization and intelligent technologies are rapidly developing around the world. At the same time, current laws protecting consumer rights and interests are rapidly becoming obsolete and failing to meet growing needs and new challenges in the booming digital world of smart technology. Existing consumer protection systems are too inertial and ignore individual consumer demands, local opportunities and regional features. Particular attention should therefore be paid to finding new opportunities to protect consumer rights by monitoring product quality at all stages of production and consumption. The new cyber-physical platform-based approach represents different physical and virtual modelling techniques and original smart tools for consumer protection using the Internet of Things, original smart sensors and mobile applications.

articleTitle: The Application of Curve Model in Garment Pattern Design
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: With the gradual penetration of computer technology into the clothing industry, the traditional fashion design mode has been broken, and efficiency has become the key word in the production of the clothing industry. People hope that clothing pattern can be generated and transmitted quickly. However, the traditional drawing exchange format - DXF - is very inconvenient because it depends heavily on the software. Therefore, the clothing industry seeks a new transmission mode in order to achieve rapid production and transmission, which inevitably involves the fitting of clothing pattern curves. This paper makes experiments and analyses on the application of common curve models in clothing, aiming at screening out curve models suitable for garment pattern, and promoting the process of clothing digitalization.

articleTitle: Application of Key Technologies of Intelligent Manufacturing in Metallurgical Industry Led by Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Intelligent manufacturing, as a product of the deep integration of manufacturing and information technology, is the core technology of the new round of industrial revolution.
