The new generation of artificial intelligence presents new features such as deep learning, cross-border integration, human-machine collaboration and group intelligence, which provides humans with a new way of thinking to understand complex systems and a new technology to transform nature and society. The deep integration of new generation Al technology and advanced manufacturing technology has formed a new generation of intelligent manufacturing technology, which has become the core technology of the new round of industrial revolution and is the core driver of the fourth industrial revolution. However, the metallurgical industry is still in the key stage of transformation of the first generation of intelligent manufacturing (i.e. digital manufacturing), and the application of new generation of artificial intelligence technology is still in the primary stage. In order to catch up with the wave of the new round of technological revolution, it is urgent to summarize and analyze the key technologies of new generation of intelligent manufacturing with the industry characteristics of metallurgical industry. This paper analyzes the current development status of metallurgical industry, and analyzes and explores the application of new generation of key technologies of intelligent manufacturing such as intelligent machine tools, intelligent inspection technology, digital twin and 3D printing technology in metallurgical industry, which has certain practical significance for the transformation and upgrading of metallurgical industry for intelligent transformation, and can be used as a reference for relevant personnel.

articleTitle: Word-level Textual Adversarial Attack Method Based On Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Deep neural networks are now widely used, but adversarial attack methods against deep neural networks are also proliferating, posing a significant security risk to deep learning. Adversarial attacks expose shortcomings of neural network, and for text it is also more challenging. Because text is discrete and cannot be optimized directly using gradients like images. Some existing word-level textual adversarial attack methods have achieved good performance, but there are still problems that the generated text is not of high enough quality or semantic bias. In this paper, we propose a model that combine the sememe-based word substitution method with the improved differential evolution algorithm to solve above problems. We have made a series of improvements to the differential evolution algorithm, including the use of dynamic cross-rates and scaling factors to enhance the search capability of the algorithm. The Metropolis criterion is also introduced to enhance the algorithm’s ability to explore the adversarial examples in the potential space. As a black-box attack method, the algorithm can attack without knowing the model’s interior. We tested the attack effectiveness of the model on benchmark datasets by attacking two victim models (BERT and BiLSTM). The experimental results shows that our model has higher attack success rate and higher quality of the adversarial examples than the baseline methods.

articleTitle: Summarize of multi-sensor information fusion technology for USV colony
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: It has gained much attention since the birth of multi-source information fusion technology for its excellent overall system performance. This paper introduces the principle of multi-source information fusion and extends the model structure of target fusion, the fusion methods and practice problems such as target detection fusion, target position fusion, target identification fusion, STA and sensor control are summarized. Finally according to the complex environment, topology, network bandwidth and other practical requirements in the multi-source information fusion of USV colony, it provides support for The relevant research directions are given, it provides support for the follow-up research on information fusion of USV colony.

articleTitle: Identification of Critical Financing Risk Factors in Urban Underground Utility Tunnel Based on Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: The urban underground utility tunnel project has begun to be actively promoted and popularized in China. Simultaneously, to effectively ensure the smooth development of the utility tunnel project, the potential impact of the project financing risk must not be overlooked. Firstly, the system of risk factors for utility tunnel financing should be established from the perspective of each participant and the whole life cycle. Similarly, the coupling relationship and degree of risk should also be identified based on the complex network theory, and a weighted directed network diagram should also be constructed. Subsequently, based on the risk level of the risk factor itself along with its local and global influence on various other factors in the network, the importance evaluation index of the risk factor is successfully designed. Finally, the BWM-PROMETHEE II method has been employed to rank the importance of risk factors and to successfully filter out the key risk factors. The results indicated that the approval delay risk, contract risk, entry tunnel pricing risk and interest rate risk were the key risk factors involved.

articleTitle: Research on Application Method of Object Detection in Video
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Object detection is an important problem in the field of computer vision, which is the basis of image segmentation, object tracking, action recognition and action judgment. With the continuous efforts of many scholars, object detection develops from the traditional object detection to the deep learning-based object detection. This paper firstly summarizes the commonly used target detection methods, then summarizes and compares the mainstream detection methods, and points out the advantages and disadvantages of some main methods. Finally, the development of target detection is predicted and prospected.

articleTitle: Research Fronts on Plant Protection Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) from the Joint of Papers and Patents
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data and Internet of Things (3CBIT)
abstract: Plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) has been greatly developed since the new millennium, and therefore many new technologies and products have emerged. It is difficult for researchers to seek key technologies and fronts from millions of publications. This paper established a process of publication search strategy and took plant protection UAV as an example to test the strategy. The search strategy of combination of paper and patent is a feasible method for screen research fronts. Agronomy and crop science is the most widely used field of plant protection UAV, followed by forestry and horticulture. China is a leading country on plant protection UAV and contributes most of the publications. South China Agriculture University, Shenzhen Dajiang Technology Co. Ltd. and Spanish National Research Council are among the top organizations. The fronts of plant protection UAV include detection and recognition of target and variable spraying, droplet deposition and drift, flight path design and anti-crash function, releasing of nature enemy.
